Pride and Progress News - highlights: 1. New York Executive Order #50 - a non-discrimination policy on city contactors 2. Interview with Willy Smith, Gay and Lesbian Inter-Religious Coalition COMMERCIAL: "New York Native," with Quentin Crisp 3. Interview with Nancy Roth, executive director of Gay Rights National Lobby, Washington D.C. COMMERCIAL: Chamberlain and Associates, Career Service Professionals 4. AIDS fears in court 5. Interview with Tim Sweeney, director of LAMBDA Legal Defense, discussing LAMBDA's AIDS Legal Guide COMMERCIAL: "Rome Adventure," Orpheo Travel Agency 6. Interview with Reverend Karen Zeigler, director of Metropolitan Community Church, discussing their on-going application to the National Council of Churches COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" 7. Gay and lesbian child custody announcement 8. LAMBDA Democrats, authors night COMMERCIAL: Arcos Blancos Resort, San Juan, Puerto Rico 9. Heathline: Conversations with GMHC: Dr. Jeffrey Lawrence, NY Hospital, Cornell Medical Center, discusses new directions in treating AIDS COMMERCIAL: "Badlands," NYC gay bar 10. Sports Report: Interview with Jim Link and Leslie Randolph, Rambler Soccer Club
The Right Stuff: 1. 1984 Halloween on Christopher Street, NYC COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay/lesbian newspaper 2. Lo Nardo, music group, performing COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" 3. Broadway star Vivian Blaine performing "live" at SAGE Benefit at the Limelight, NYC. Songs: "Guys and Dolls medley" COMMERCIAL: National Fund for Human Dignity with Abigail "Dear Abby" Van Buren 4. Media Report: "Hollywood Babylon II," Japanese condoms, Cardinal Spellman, Michael Musto receives Village Voice column COMMERCIAL: Spur Production 5. 1984 Halloween coverage/ Closing credits
